summary: Tested new Secretary STAFF management (Paie & Congés) endpoints and UI. Backend: 8/8 pytest passed in test_secretary_staff.py covering GET /api/secretary/all-staff (returns 1+ staff w/ 30d leaves_total, 401 without token), full CRUD on /api/secretary/staff-payments (POST computes montant_net = amount+bonus-deductions*deduction_unit, EUR=5€/deduction; invoice_ref STAFF-XXX-YYYYMM-####; GET & DELETE verified) and /api/secretary/staff-leaves (POST persists 5-day leave, GET returns it with status='approved', DELETE removes it). Frontend: Secretary code login secretaire2025 succeeds → /secretary; Facturation tab renders 'Bulletin de Salaire - STAFFS' section (with 'Membre du Staff' dropdown showing 'Chargé(e) de Com (communication)'), and 'Gestion des Congés - STAFFS (30j/an)' section with Solde by staff (24j restants after 6d existing leave) + Bulletins/Congés Récents lists. All 6 requested Tests 1–6 pass.

minor.issue: amount/bonus/deductions float()/int() coerced with no bounds check — negative values accepted (montant_net clamped >=0 but negative amount/bonus not blocked). Add Pydantic validation (ge=0).

No validation that end_date >= start_date, and days_used trusted from client (not recomputed from dates). Client could send 5 days but 100 days_used. Also no check against remaining balance (30j/an) — server accepts overuse; UI-only enforcement.
leaves_used is hard-coded to 0 regardless of existing staff_leaves records; UI computes remaining separately, but endpoint contract is misleading. Consider aggregating from db.staff_leaves.
When no staff users exist, endpoint returns fake seed [MBM, FZT] with id='MBM'/'FZT' (strings, not user UUIDs) — could break staff_payments.staff_id foreign linkage if referenced elsewhere.

issues: No data-testid on 'Membre du Staff' select, amount/bonus/deductions inputs, '✅ Enregistrer le Bulletin de Salaire' button, nor on Congé form. Automated testing had to fall back to French label selectors.
File remains >2300 lines (SecretaryDashboard.js) — repeatedly flagged since iteration_13. Consider splitting Facturation/STAFFS/RH into sub-components.

action_items: Add Pydantic validation on staff-payments (amount/bonus>=0, deductions>=0, valid currency enum) and staff-leaves (end_date>=start_date, days_used derived server-side, respect 30j/an remaining balance).
Fix GET /secretary/all-staff so leaves_used reflects real db.staff_leaves sum; consider removing the hard-coded MBM/FZT fallback (or return real user IDs).
Add data-testid attributes on STAFFS section: staff-select, staff-amount-input, staff-bonus-input, staff-deductions-input, staff-payment-submit, staff-leave-*.
critical_code_review_comments: secretary.py all-staff seeds fake IDs (MBM/FZT) when no communication user exists — will not resolve to real user records elsewhere.
staff-payments & staff-leaves reuse both camelCase and snake_case keys AND persist both in the document — bloats storage; pick one convention or normalize on read.
SecretaryDashboard.js is >2300 lines — flagged in iteration_13 & 14, still unresolved.
Logo integration was documented but not visually verified (would require printing PDF from browser); recommend main agent self-verify by clicking print buttons.
test_credentials: Read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Used: secretary code secretaire2025 for UI; secretaire@mykalamaenglish.com/kalamasecret for backend token.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create+delete TEST_ staff payment (MBM 2026-01, 400+50-10=440€) and TEST_ staff leave (MBM 2026-02-01→05, 5j). Full teardown performed in tests. One pre-existing leave (Chargé(e) de Com 6j, 20-25/12/2025) present from prior manual testing.
